literal: Themselves that which they enjoy, the world to rejoice having seen, they will desire, those who have learned and known.
translation: Seeing that the world rejoices in the very knowledge that they themselves enjoy, those who have learned and acquired wisdom will desire to learn even more.
modern: தாம் இன்பம் அடையும் கல்வியறிவை உலகமும் பெற்று இன்பமடைவதைக் கண்டு, கற்றறிந்தவர்கள் மேலும் மேலும் கற்க விரும்புவார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the profound joy of learning and its social impact. Scholars find personal delight in their own wisdom, but their joy is multiplied when they see the world benefit and rejoice from that same knowledge. The term 'காமுறுவர்' indicates a passionate desire or love, showing that the learned do not grow weary of study; instead, seeing others happy because of their knowledge inspires them to pursue learning even more eagerly.
